relation_vocabulary.related: the axis measures a behaviour that bears on the ASI risk; it does not cover, test for, mitigate, or show resistance to it

asi_entries.title: Agent Goal Hijack
asi_entries.note: No board axis injects instructions through content, tools or retrieved data. Refusal calibration (safety) is not goal-hijack resistance.

asi_entries.title: Tool Misuse
asi_entries.title_note: Title as it appears in the announcement text ('ASI02 – Tool Misuse'). docs/owasp-agentic-crosswalk.md uses 'Tool Misuse & Exploitation'; the longer form was not checked against the published document here.

asi_entries.title: Memory & Context Poisoning
asi_entries.note: No board axis poisons memory or context. A separate repository (CSOAI-ORG/memory-poisoning-axis) exists but is not a board axis and is not counted here.

mapping.why_related: MCPBench scores whether a model calls MCP tools within their declared contract; using a legitimate tool outside its intent is the ASI02 risk.
mapping.not_established: Conformance on a frozen bank is not resistance to adversarial tool misuse or exploitation.

mapping.why_related: MCP servers and tool schemas are agentic supply-chain components, and the axis exercises a model against them.
mapping.not_established: It measures model conformance to tool contracts, not the integrity or provenance of the components.

mapping.task: autonomous agent action authority (PROCEED / CONFIRM / REFUSE)
mapping.why_related: XRAIV asks whether an autonomous agent should PROCEED, CONFIRM or REFUSE before acting — the decision point where tools get used beyond intent.
mapping.not_established: Action-authority judgement on a bank is not observed tool behaviour in a deployed agent.

mapping.task: autonomous agent action authority (PROCEED / CONFIRM / REFUSE)
mapping.why_related: Acting beyond granted authority is the privilege half of ASI03.
mapping.not_established: No credential, identity, delegation or token handling is tested.

mapping.why_related: SwarmBench v2b measures safety of multi-agent coordination, which runs over inter-agent messages.
mapping.not_established: Message authentication, spoofing and channel security are not tested.

mapping.why_related: Coordination failures between agents are one route by which a fault propagates across a system.
mapping.not_established: No end-to-end cascade across real pipelines is measured.

mapping.task: escape-attempt detection on 71-cell gold bank (38 ESCAPE / 33 BENIGN) — layer 2 of 2
mapping.why_related: GoldBank-Detector measures detection of escape attempts from containment — a detection layer next to unexpected execution.
mapping.not_established: It is not a sandbox or code-execution test, and detection is not prevention.

mapping.task: escape-attempt detection on 71-cell gold bank (38 ESCAPE / 33 BENIGN) — layer 2 of 2
mapping.why_related: Escape attempts are one observable of an agent acting outside its sanctioned scope.
mapping.not_established: Misalignment, deception or persistence of a rogue agent are not measured.

mapping.why_related: AffectBench measures manipulation, disclosure and vulnerability handling — the behaviours through which an agent can exploit a human's trust.
mapping.not_established: Responses on a frozen bank, not deployed agent-human interaction or operator approval flows.

mapping.task: EU AI Act Article 5 prohibited-practice trip
mapping.why_related: Article 5 prohibited practices include manipulative and exploitative techniques; the axis measures whether a model trips on them.
mapping.not_established: A legal-category trip test, not a measure of trust exploitation in agent workflows.

unmapped_axes.reason: EU AI Act risk-tier classification is a regulatory-reasoning task with no agentic threat surface.
Calibrated refusal on paired direct requests; no injected or indirect instruction is present, so it does not bear on goal hijack (ASI01).
Article 50 marking survival concerns synthetic-content labelling, not an ASI risk; a link to ASI09 would be too weak to state.
Post-quantum status of cryptographic assumptions; not an agentic application risk.
Licence reasoning against intended use; licence terms are not a supply-chain security property.
Machinery Regulation safety-function classification; not an agentic application risk.
Care-cost (protect x help) in paired conduct scenarios; no ASI entry names this behaviour.
Cross-detector watermark interoperability; not an agentic application risk.
